title: World Cup top scorers since 1994
brief: Name the ten players with the most World Cup finals goals from 1994 to 2026.
period: World Cups 1994 to 2026. Goals before 1994 don't count.

notes.Jurgen Klinsmann: Jurgen Klinsmann has 11 World Cup goals, but 3 came in 1990, so 8 count here, just outside.
notes.Rivaldo: Rivaldo is joint 12th with 8, just outside.
notes.Romelu Lukaku: Romelu Lukaku is joint 12th with 8, just outside.
notes.Jude Bellingham: Jude Bellingham is joint 12th with 8, just outside.
notes.Roberto Baggio: Roberto Baggio has 9 World Cup goals, but 2 came in 1990, so 7 count here.
notes.Just Fontaine: Just Fontaine's 13 goals came in 1958, before 1994.
notes.Gerd Muller: Gerd Muller's 14 goals came in 1970 and 1974, before 1994.
notes.Gary Lineker: Gary Lineker's 10 goals came in 1986 and 1990, before 1994.

checks: Totals summed from every tournament's goalscorer list on Wikipedia (each list's total checked against the tournament's goals minus own goals). Each top-ten total agrees with Transfermarkt's all-time World Cup scorers list once pre-1994 goals are removed (Klinsmann 3 and Baggio 2 in 1990; Batistuta's first World Cup was 1994). Three players on 9 share the last two places.
